words.gloss: to the place where he is

literal: Like the mind, to the place where he is, if they could go, in a flood of water, swim they would not, alas, my eyes.
translation: If my eyes could only travel to the place where my beloved is, just as my mind does, they would not have to swim in this flood of tears.
modern: என் நெஞ்சத்தைப் போல, என் காதலர் இருக்கும் இடத்திற்கு என் கண்களும் செல்ல முடியுமானால், அவை இந்த வெள்ளப் பெருக்கான கண்ணீரில் நீந்த வேண்டியிருக்காது.
explanation: The heroine laments her state of separation, where her eyes constantly weep. She notes that her mind has the ability to instantly travel to where her beloved resides. If only her eyes could do the same and go to that place, they would be gazing upon him instead of crying. Consequently, they would not have to swim in a flood of their own tears. The particles 'மன்னோ' express her deep regret and longing.
